verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents its own headless, programmatic surfaces: a Gateway process you can run in a throwaway Docker environment, an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, a direct tool-invoke HTTP endpoint, and HTTP hooks that let an external service submit an agent turn. Together these support unattended automation. Nothing in the evidence describes CI usage specifically, such as pipeline recipes, non-interactive one-shot CLI runs, or exit-code semantics. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration, non-interactive one-shot CLI execution mode, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use it for an isolated, throwaway Gateway environment or a host without local installs.
Gateway HTTP hooks let an external service wake an agent or submit an agent turn.
The Gateway can serve a small OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface.
OpenClaw's Gateway exposes an HTTP endpoint for invoking a single tool directly.
